interactions.name: Sauron ward
interactions.finding: When an opponent targets Sauron, ward requires that player to sacrifice a legendary artifact or legendary creature or the spell/ability is countered by ward.

interactions.name: Opponent-spell amass trigger
interactions.finding: Whenever an opponent casts a spell, Sauron triggers and amasses Orcs 1 on resolution. That triggered ability is independent of the opponent spell once triggered.

interactions.name: Army combat into Ring engine
interactions.finding: Whenever an Army controlled by the Sauron player deals combat damage to a player, the Ring tempts that player. Each Ring temptation separately triggers Sauron’s optional discard-hand/draw-four ability.

interactions.name: Nazgûl construction and Ring triggers
interactions.finding: Nazgûl explicitly permits up to nine copies; seven is legal. Each Nazgûl independently triggers whenever the Ring tempts its controller and puts a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith controlled by that player.

interactions.name: Mauhúr replacement
interactions.finding: If one or more +1/+1 counters would be put on an Army, Goblin, or Orc controlled by the player, Mauhúr replaces that event with that many plus one counters, not one extra counter per counter.

interactions.name: The Great Goblin counter trigger
interactions.finding: The Great Goblin triggers once for each event that puts one or more counters on a Goblin, Orc, or Army controlled by its controller, not once for each individual counter.

interactions.name: Great Goblin, Foul-Hearted
interactions.finding: Its enter/attack trigger amasses Goblins 3. Amassing onto an existing Army adds Goblin to that Army’s creature types, and its static ability gives Armies controlled by its controller trample.

interactions.name: Minas Morgul Army-Wraith bridge
interactions.finding: A shadow counter from Minas Morgul makes the target a Wraith in addition to its other types and gives it shadow while the counter remains. An Army made into a Wraith can then receive counters from each Nazgûl Ring trigger while remaining an Army for Sauron’s combat-damage trigger.

interactions.name: Roaming Throne — Avatar mode
interactions.finding: Choosing Avatar makes Roaming Throne an Avatar and causes triggered abilities of other Avatars controlled by its controller, including Sauron, to trigger an additional time. Each doubled Sauron trigger is a separate trigger.

interactions.name: Roaming Throne — Wraith mode
interactions.finding: Choosing Wraith instead causes each Nazgûl triggered ability to trigger an additional time because each Nazgûl is a Wraith. This does not simultaneously double Sauron because only one creature type is chosen.

interactions.name: Force of Will support
interactions.finding: The candidate retains 21 other blue nonland cards by current color-identity/type metadata, providing a sufficient functional pitch pool for Force of Will.

interactions.name: Wonder and Anger
interactions.finding: The revised mana base retains an Island basic plus Island-typed duals for Wonder and Mountain basics plus Mountain-typed duals for Anger.

interactions.name: Widespread Brutality
interactions.finding: The spell amasses first, then the chosen Army deals damage equal to its power to each non-Army creature; the Army itself is not a non-Army creature.
